name: Grade 7 IIT Practice: August Week 10 - Build
description: Practice words for building and testing dance game logic.

words.definition: A smaller named part of a program that can be reused.
words.example: The jump subroutine reused the same movement blocks.

words.definition: A key press, click, or sprite touch that the Scratch game uses.
words.example: A key press was the input that started the action.

words.definition: A Scratch rule that checks touching, score, or timer before choosing an action.
words.example: The condition checked whether the sprite touched the goal.

words.definition: Peer comments used to improve the screen, controls, or instructions.
words.example: Peer feedback helped the student improve the start screen.

words.definition: Trying something to see if it works.
words.example: Testing found that the timer was too short.
The bug made the score reset during the game.
